name: Login Admin
solution: SQL injection on /rest/user/login: send email="admin@juice-sh.op'--" to close the quoted SQL string and comment the password check. Returns a valid admin JWT.

name: Login Jim
solution: Same SQLi trick as Login Admin but with Jim's email.

name: Login Bender
solution: SQLi variant of the Login Admin attack. Any email followed by the comment marker ' -- bypasses the password check.

name: Admin Section
solution: Angular route /#/administration renders the admin panel. Discoverable by reading the main.js bundle and searching for 'administration'.

name: Score Board
solution: Hidden Angular route /#/score-board. Even without auth it renders the solved/unsolved list — the existence of the route is the challenge.

name: Admin Registration
solution: The User registration endpoint accepts the `role` field although the UI never sends it. Set role=admin to register as admin.

name: User Credentials
solution: UNION-based SQLi on /rest/products/search?q= — close the IN() with ')) and UNION-select the users table columns. The admin hash surfaces as product name.

name: Confidential Document
solution: The /ftp/ directory is accessible. Fetch the acquisitions.md file — it contains confidential Juice Shop M&A plans.

name: Forgotten Developer Backup
solution: Poison null byte bypass. The .bak extension is blocked, but appending %00.md tricks the static file server into serving package.json.bak as if it were a .md file.

name: Easter Egg
solution: Same %00 bypass as Forgotten Backup. The file eastere.gg is blocked by the .gg regex but accepted when renamed via null byte.

name: Poison Null Byte
solution: The fixed file filter uses endsWith('.md') but node's path handling stops at %00. Use any file + %00.md to bypass.

name: Reset Jim's Password
solution: Jim's security question is 'Your eldest siblings middle name'. Public Star Trek data reveals Samuel as the answer (Spock's brother Sybok → wait, Jim = Jim Kirk → George Samuel Kirk).

name: Reset Bender's Password
solution: Bender from Futurama: 'Name of your favorite stunt performer?' → Stop'n'Drop. The apostrophes are the trick — must be escaped in JSON.

name: Exposed Metrics
solution: Prometheus metrics endpoint /metrics is exposed without auth. Standard observability misconfig.

name: Deprecated Interface
solution: The /file-upload endpoint accepts .xml files (deprecated MIME). Upload any .xml to trigger the challenge.

name: XXE Data Access
payload: echo '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE x [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]><x>&xxe;</x>' > /tmp/xxe.xml && curl -s -X POST -F 'file=@/tmp/xxe.xml' http://juice.local:3000/file-upload
solution: Upload an XML file with SYSTEM entity referencing a local file (/etc/passwd, /etc/hostname). The XML parser resolves the entity and returns the file contents.

name: View Basket
solution: IDOR on /rest/basket/:id. The server does not verify the requested basket belongs to the JWT user — just fetches by id. Enumerate from 1 upwards.

name: Manipulate Basket
solution: Modify BasketId in the BasketItems POST body to a basket other than your own — server trusts the client-supplied BasketId.

name: Change Product Chart
payload: curl -s -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ' -d '{"description":"Got coupon"}' http://juice.local:3000/api/Products/1
solution: Admin can PUT /api/Products/:id with arbitrary HTML in the description. Needs admin role (see loginAdminChallenge).

name: Forged Signed JWT
payload: # Python: use jwt.encode(payload, key='', algorithm='HS256') with key from misused RSA pub key. See PentesterLab JWT whitepaper.
solution: Juice Shop uses RS256 but the verifier also accepts HS256. Grab the RS256 public key from /encryptionkeys or the JWT header 'x5c', then sign a payload with HS256 using the pub key as HMAC secret.

name: Forgotten Signed JWT
payload: # Craft JWT with {"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"} header and {"data":{"email":"admin@juice-sh.op","role":"admin"}} payload, empty signature.
solution: alg=none bypass. Older jsonwebtoken libraries accept a token with no signature if the header declares alg=none.

name: API-Only XSS
solution: The product name is rendered unescaped in the admin panel. Admin posts a product name containing <iframe src=javascript:alert()> and the XSS fires on page view.

name: Outdated Allowlist
solution: Open-redirect bypass. The allowlist checks if any allowed URL substring is in the ?to= value, not the actual destination. Chain an allowed URL in the querystring: /redirect?to=https://external.com?honey=https://github.com/bkimminich/juice-shop

name: Five-Star Feedback
solution: Feedback is only deletable by admin role. Log in as admin (loginAdmin) and DELETE any feedback entry to trigger the challenge.

name: Error Handling
solution: Trigger any unhandled exception — the default error handler prints a full stack trace.

name: Expired Coupon
solution: The coupon y000y000CY is expired but applies anyway because server doesn't validate expiration. Coupon codes are base64-derived from date.

name: CSRF
solution: POST cross-origin to /rest/user/change-password with a spoofed Origin header. The server accepts change-password via GET query string too, making it CSRFable.

name: Ephemeral Accountant
solution: The accountant user is soft-deleted in the DB but still present. SQLi bypass with accountant@juice-sh.op' -- logs in as the deleted account.

name: Access Log
solution: The /support/logs directory is exposed and contains per-day HTTP access logs with user IPs, tokens and auth headers.

name: Premium Paywall
solution: The hidden paywall route is the URL itself. No actual paywall check — the route string is the challenge.

name: Extra Language
solution: The tlh_AA (Klingon) locale file is hidden behind a locale-picker filter but served directly from /assets/i18n/.

name: Forged Feedback
payload: curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <user-jwt>' -d '{"comment":"I am someone else","rating":5,"UserId":1}' http://juice.local:3000/api/Feedbacks
solution: Include UserId in the POST body — server trusts it over the JWT user. Set UserId=1 to post a feedback on behalf of admin.

name: Misplaced Signature File
solution: Same null-byte trick — the suspicious_errors.yml file is the signed manifest exposed via FTP.

name: Null Byte
solution: Any non-md, non-pdf file followed by %00.md bypasses the file-type filter.

name: Empty User Registration
solution: POST empty string email+password. SQLite INSERT accepts '' and creates a user with empty credentials.

name: CAPTCHA Bypass
payload: # Loop POST /api/Feedbacks 10 times with valid captcha ID but without solving it.
solution: Submit 10 feedbacks in < 10 seconds. The captcha gate is a simple rate-limit that can be re-submitted.

name: Token Sale
solution: Hidden Angular route /#/tokensale-ico-ea. Discoverable in main.js by searching for 'tokensale'.

name: NoSQL Orders
solution: The /rest/track-order/:id endpoint does NoSQL pattern matching. Sending 'or 1=1-- or a regex like .* returns all orders.

name: Arbitrary File Write
payload: # Upload a zip with path traversal in filename (../../../etc/something)
solution: The multer unzip handler doesn't sanitize entry names. Upload a zip with ../../escape in the filename to write outside uploads/.
